capabilities: Highlight PDF pages and attach sticky notes or text boxes
OCR scanned pages and images into text
Translate text with online or offline models
Read text aloud and save per-sentence audio
Create SRS flashcards and export them to Anki
extras: On first use it downloads the NLLB translation model (~900 MB), Piper voices and Tesseract OCR files from jsdelivr.net or huggingface.co, then runs them offline; Google Translate is the only feature that always needs internet. Installation is manual until the plugin is accepted into the community directory.
motivation: The author wanted an offline-first design that protects source privacy and keeps PDFs, Markdown, translation, listening and review together in one vault, with no constant switching between apps.
problem: Reading, translating, listening to and reviewing study material is spread across separate apps, so PDFs, notes and flashcards do not live together in the vault.

relations.evidence: Export to Anki (.apkg) — cards + audio, opens in Anki Desktop and AnkiDroid.

summary: Offline-first study workspace that adds PDF highlighting, sticky notes, OCR, translation, TTS, SRS flashcards and a Pomodoro timer to Obsidian.
